scope: All 49 published profiles; direction, provenance, totals and stars
conclusion: The former clarity label was ambiguous. Existing stored values were difficulty values already. Do not apply 11-minus-score: that would reverse correctly directed estimates.
direction: Every axis: 1 easier, 10 harder. Axis 4: 辨音難度 / Vocal decoding difficulty.
limits: Editorial estimates, not learner-calibrated measurements. This is a direction/provenance audit, not a fresh audio-listening assessment. Eleven later profiles have less documented individual reasoning. No unsupported numeric changes were made.

profiles.evidence: Original clarityDifficulty axis; unchanged six scores and original note
profiles.originalNote: 主歌的短句接得較緊，搖滾人聲與伴奏重疊；留意句尾輔音及表達情緒的片語。

profiles.evidence: Original clarityDifficulty axis; unchanged six scores and original note
profiles.originalNote: 節奏舒緩，但句子常跨越拍點；留意代名詞、助動詞的弱讀，以及比喻愛情的表達。

profiles.evidence: Original clarityDifficulty axis; unchanged six scores and original note
profiles.originalNote: 快速節拍配合高音與拉長母音，字尾較難辨清；主歌與副歌的唱法差異亦增加難度。

profiles.evidence: Original clarityDifficulty axis; unchanged six scores and original note
profiles.originalNote: 歌詞量少且重複較多；長音和漸強人聲需要辨清，部分意象要結合上下文理解。

profiles.evidence: Original clarityDifficulty axis; unchanged six scores and original note
profiles.originalNote: 發音與句子間隔較清楚；挑戰主要來自宗教、社會與理想世界等抽象詞義。

profiles.evidence: Original clarityDifficulty axis; unchanged six scores and original note
profiles.originalNote: 唱詞疏落、旋律舒緩；條件句和詩意比喻比節奏更需要細讀。

profiles.evidence: Original clarityDifficulty axis; unchanged six scores and original note
profiles.originalNote: 鋼琴伴奏讓人聲突出；句中連讀、反義對照和感情比喻是主要辨聽重點。

profiles.evidence: Original clarityDifficulty axis; unchanged six scores and original note
profiles.originalNote: 旋律留有空間，但抽象意象和合成人聲質感提高理解負擔；注意重複句中的細節。

profiles.evidence: Original clarityDifficulty axis; unchanged six scores and original note
profiles.originalNote: 慢速複拍與重複副歌較易跟上；留意輕聲唱出的功能詞及長音之間的字界。

profiles.evidence: Original clarityDifficulty axis; unchanged six scores and original note
profiles.originalNote: 搖滾聲線、密集短句與口語縮略同時出現；慣用語和文化指涉也需要留意。

profiles.evidence: Original clarityDifficulty axis; unchanged six scores and original note
profiles.originalNote: 平行句式與重複詞語有助預測；重點是分辨每行替換的動詞，避免只憑熟悉旋律作答。

profiles.evidence: Original clarityDifficulty axis; unchanged six scores and original note
profiles.originalNote: 敘事句與比較表達清楚，但輕聲連讀容易吞掉小詞；注意代名詞及時間線索。

profiles.evidence: Original clarityDifficulty axis; unchanged six scores and original note
profiles.originalNote: 男女聲交替及合唱使字界更緊密；口語縮略與承諾類片語是主要挑戰。

profiles.evidence: Original clarityDifficulty axis; unchanged six scores and original note
profiles.originalNote: 主歌敘事密集，兩位歌手的咬字與語氣不同；長句、弱讀及關係類片語需要持續追蹤。

profiles.evidence: Original clarityDifficulty axis; unchanged six scores and original note
profiles.originalNote: 地名、景物與抽象意象增加詞彙負擔；長句配合多層和聲，需仔細辨認重音以外的字。

profiles.evidence: Original clarityDifficulty axis; unchanged six scores and original note
profiles.originalNote: 鋼琴節拍推進較快，唱詞本身仍有空間；留意長母音、連讀及地景比喻。

profiles.evidence: Original clarityDifficulty axis; unchanged six scores and original note
profiles.originalNote: 氣聲、節奏化唱法及口語對話交替；縮略語、弱讀和副歌的小幅變化容易混淆。

profiles.evidence: Original clarityDifficulty axis; unchanged six scores and original note
profiles.originalNote: 故事主歌包含工作與生活片語，副歌有明顯省音；沙啞聲線和強勁伴奏增加辨聽負擔。

profiles.evidence: Original clarityDifficulty axis; unchanged six scores and original note
profiles.originalNote: 慢板情歌以拉長音節為主；需辨清句尾和較輕的連接詞，並理解關係修復的比喻。

profiles.evidence: Original clarityDifficulty axis; unchanged six scores and original note
profiles.originalNote: 人聲平穩、重複句多；留意回憶敘事中的動詞，以及珍惜與失去的片語。

profiles.evidence: Original clarityDifficulty axis; unchanged six scores and original note
profiles.originalNote: 咬字清楚，但搖擺節奏會改變字與拍的對齊；想像性的表達與連讀值得留意。

profiles.evidence: Original clarityDifficulty axis; unchanged six scores and original note
profiles.originalNote: 抒情、歌劇與搖滾段落快速轉換，含罕見詞語與多層合唱；整曲負擔遠高於開首慢拍所示。

profiles.evidence: Original clarityDifficulty axis; unchanged six scores and original note
profiles.originalNote: 副歌短而重複，詞彙負擔較低；電子伴奏與高音會遮蓋部分字尾。

profiles.evidence: Original clarityDifficulty axis; unchanged six scores and original note
profiles.originalNote: 副歌句子較長，人聲由輕唱轉為強烈高音；留意省音和連續的否定表達。

profiles.evidence: Original clarityDifficulty axis; unchanged six scores and original note
profiles.originalNote: 短句及重複副歌較易掌握；和聲中的弱讀、代名詞與句子銜接仍需細聽。

profiles.evidence: Original clarityDifficulty axis; unchanged six scores and original note
profiles.originalNote: 敘事主歌包含城市生活詞彙，句子接續較緊；注意省去字尾的唱法及比喻表達。

profiles.evidence: Original clarityDifficulty axis; unchanged six scores and original note
profiles.originalNote: 快速節拍、口語橋段與大量俚語疊加；副歌雖重複，主歌及說唱式段落仍十分密集。

profiles.evidence: Original clarityDifficulty axis; unchanged six scores and original note
profiles.originalNote: 日常詞彙為主，但較長的句子把小詞連在一起；需追蹤時間、位置與代名詞。

profiles.evidence: Original clarityDifficulty axis; unchanged six scores and original note
profiles.originalNote: 反覆句有助跟唱，口語縮略與帶情緒的延音仍會改變字界；注意條件句與轉折。

profiles.evidence: Original clarityDifficulty axis; unchanged six scores and original note
profiles.originalNote: 歷史、宗教與權力意象使詞義較抽象；密集敘事和連續重拍需要較快的處理速度。

profiles.evidence: Original clarityDifficulty axis; unchanged six scores and original note
profiles.originalNote: 唱詞不算密集，但沙啞音色與高音會弱化輔音；抽象的自我表達需要上下文。

profiles.evidence: Original clarityDifficulty axis; unchanged six scores and original note
profiles.originalNote: 故事線清楚、常用詞多；輕唱和連讀容易把短詞合在一起，長音亦會改變字的節奏。

profiles.evidence: Original clarityDifficulty axis; unchanged six scores and original note
profiles.originalNote: 旋律溫和，主歌卻有多組連續短詞；雙人和聲及反覆句的小變化需要辨認。

profiles.evidence: Original clarityDifficulty axis; unchanged six scores and original note
profiles.originalNote: 情緒強烈的沙啞高音配合長句與比喻；功能詞常被壓短，字尾也容易融入伴奏。

profiles.evidence: Original clarityDifficulty axis; unchanged six scores and original note
profiles.originalNote: 發音相對清楚，但回顧人生的慣用語和較正式詞彙較多；自由延音會改變句子的節奏。

profiles.evidence: Original clarityDifficulty axis; unchanged six scores and original note
profiles.originalNote: 短句中包含隱喻與社會處境詞彙；輕聲連讀密集，表面簡單的詞也可能承載隱含意思。

profiles.evidence: Original clarityDifficulty axis; unchanged six scores and original note
profiles.originalNote: 旋律舒緩、句式重複；辨聽重點是較輕的功能詞，以及合唱中的字尾。

profiles.evidence: Original clarityDifficulty axis; unchanged six scores and original note
profiles.originalNote: 中速節拍和重複副歌有助跟上；留意句內連讀、感情片語與和聲中的輔音。
